bundle: Check or summarize a portable bundle offline (no server or account needed)
changes: The project event log: its head, pages after a cursor, or follow it live
check: Say what is newer than what you hold, what is new and what you can no longer see
checks: Checks against a reference: publish, list, compare a result with a file, and who may publish
correct: Run and explicitly publish the bounded offset example
curves: A depth window of one exact curve for display: every sample (level 0) or blocks with their extrema
dependents: The results made from an exact version you may read
doctor: Check local setup without running code or contacting the server
entities: List the wells and wellbores you may read
export: Export exact revisions into a new portable bundle
fetch: Read an exact revision into a new local folder
get: Get the latest version of an item into a new or held folder; you then hold it
init: Start an application from a packaged template (map-application, derive-and-publish, sync-worker, notebook, agent-workflow)
list: List permitted scientific assets without a run
login: Approve this project in your browser
org-connections: Your organisation's database connections that you use or administer, with your own readiness
orgs: List the organisations holding a project the credential reaches
prepare: Fetch exact input; no computation or publication
projects: List the projects a credential reaches (no configuration or project needed)
publish: Publish the prepared result; does not share it
publish-derived: Publish a file you derived from exact revisions, with its declared method (a command id or a work folder is required)
read-data: Read well tops, a trajectory or a horizon grid at an exact revision and save it
recover: Recover a saved exact request from its private work folder
remake: Make an exact result version again and compare; nothing is saved without --save
run: Execute your prepared Python script on this computer
send: Send a file as a new item, or as the next version of one you hold; it is private until you share it
share: Give colleagues read or reuse access to a result or original you own
sources: Your upstream source selections: list them, describe one (costs one full read), or read its rows
story: How an exact result version was made: its inputs and their inputs, a page at a time
targets: What each type of table needs: its fields, which are required and the choices that describe it (offline)
upload: Upload a file, a folder, a .zip or an https address: every file it can read is added, and one report says what became of each
well-imports: Import a copy of an approved well table as wells: list, status ID, start (--dry-run to preview), resume ID, cancel ID
wells: The wells you may read, located (list), or their extent
what-changed: What differs in how two exact result versions were made
